summary: [spec fidelity] When the tier refuses the second name of a digest, the prune refusal contradicts itself. Probed (chflags uchg on the plain object, debug local-fs substitute): ARTIFACTS_STORE_FAILED 'could not delete cold:<digest>: ... deleted artifacts/sha256/<digest>.zst, but could not delete artifacts/sha256/<digest>: ... Operation not permitted; nothing was deleted', hint about CANON_S3_* reachability. The brief (F5 failure, scenario 10) asks to say what was deleted; the tail 'nothing was deleted' is false because delete_blob counts a digest only when both names went (done.blobs/tier_objects stay 0 for the half-deleted one) and the code is STORE_FAILED, not ARTIFACTS_PRUNE_INCOMPLETE. The repeat does work (preview lists the digest by the plain name, --commit removes it; verified). The CLI test of scenario 10 runs only the interrupted-then-repeat half; the refusal text is covered by the canon-store unit test alone, so the contradiction is untested. Blast radius: only the prune failure message and exit path; no data is lost.
